devices: Fire TV Stick 4K Select (2025) · Fire TV Stick HD (2026) · Fire TV Stick 4K, 3rd Gen (2026)
platform_details: Vega OS 1.1 / 2.0 — Linux-based, not Android · model codes AFTCA002 · AFTCL001 · AFTCR001
compatible_players: VLC for Vega OS (Amazon Appstore, released by VideoLAN on 23 July 2026; the developer names the Fire TV Stick 4K Select and Fire TV Stick HD — on the Stick 4K 3rd Gen, search the Appstore on the device). VLC is a media player, not an IPTV service. No other player in this table publishes a Vega OS release.
supported_login_methods: VLC: VideoLAN’s announcement lists local files and SMB / UPnP-DLNA network shares; it does not document M3U playlists, Xtream Codes or portal logins on Vega.
official_installation_route: Amazon Appstore — the consumer installation route. Separately, Amazon’s Vega documentation describes a developer workflow: Developer Mode plus the Vega command-line tools, installing Vega packages (.vpkg). It is not a consumer install route.
important_limitation: Buy with care: “Fire TV Stick HD” and “Fire TV Stick 4K” are names used for both Fire OS and Vega OS generations. Check the model code or Settings › My Fire TV › About before choosing a player.
